corePassives.description: When Kensei releases his Ultimate - Explosive Uppercut, the remaining cooldowns of other teammates' Ultimates are reduced by 1.25 second(s). If the team has 1/2 other Strike characters, the cooldown reduction from his Core Passive - Surging Fistwind is multiplied by 2/4, and the buff effects from his Passive Boost - Crushing Gale, Righteous Fury, and Impatient are multiplied by 2/4.
corePassives.name: Surging Fistwind

corePassives.description: Each hit of a Special Attack applies 1 stack of Wind Pressure to the target, stacking up to 20 times. When a Strike teammate other than Kensei lands an attack, 1 Wind Pressure stack is consumed to trigger Wind Pressure Rupture, dealing extra Strike DMG equal to (Kensei's ATK x 25%). The Strike characters in the team then gain 1 stack of Wind Pressure Boost, increasing Crit DMG by 2% for 25 seconds, stacking up to 20 times. Wind Pressure Rupture counts as a Special Attack and is affected by the triggering teammate's buffs.
corePassives.name: Crushing Gale

corePassives.description: After releasing the Ultimate, the entire team gains Valor, increasing ATK by 8% for 30 seconds. Kensei also gains Reproach, increasing his ATK by 1.5% for 30 seconds.
corePassives.name: Righteous Fury

name: Kensei Muguruma (Bankai)

rotations.name: No Ult Charge
rotations.notes: Use Technique then swap out immediately.

skills.description:
Kensei pummels the enemy with four consecutive punches, dealing a total damage equal to 276% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. ~~Infused Strike~~ When Spiritual Pressure is above 50, tap Basic Attack after finishing the final hit of Basick Attack or releasing a Technique /n Kensei delivers a fierce punch, causing the power infused into the enemy to erupt repeatedly. This consumes 50 Spiritual Pressure and deals 10 hits for a total damage equal to 360% of ATK. 
 After releasing this skill, if Kensei still has more than 50 Spiritual Pressure, tap Basic Attack to cousume another 50 and use Infused Strike again, with its damage increased by 50%.
skills.name: Bankai - Tekken Tachikaze

skills.description: Kensei charges forward and strikes with hiss tored power, dealing damage equal to 536% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure.
skills.name: Power Straight

skills.description:
Kensei lands a mighty blow that triggers an explosion, dealing damage equal 796% of ATK. After releasing this skill, he gains 1 stack of Intent. ~~Thunderous Barrage~~ While having 3 stacks of Intent 
 Kensei channels  power into both fists and pummels the enemy, finishing with an explosive strike. He consumes all stacks of Intent and deals damage equal to 2760% of ATK.
skills.name: Explosive Uppercut

skills.description: Upon blocking an enemy attack, Kensei counters with a ground-shaking blow that deals damage equal to 844% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Kensei gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step

ascend1: During battle, for every 1% Crit DMG Kensei possesses, his ATK increases by 0.05%, up to 20%.

When a teammate triggers Wind Pressure Rupture through Kensei's Passive Boost - Crushing Gale, all teammates except Kensei gain 1 stack of Rupture Boost, increasing Strike Mastery by 0.5% and All-Skill Mastery by 0.5% for 25 seconds, up to 20 stacks.
After releasing a Technique, if Kensei has sufficient Spiritual Pressure and is at the backline, he automatically releases Special Attacks until all his Spiritual Pressure is consumed.
ascend5: During battle, for every 1% Crit DMG Kensei possesses, his ATK increases by 0.1%, up to 40%.

When a teammate triggers Wind Pressure Rupture through Kensei's Passive Boost - Crushing Gale, all teammates except Kensei gain 1 stack of Rupture Boost, increasing Strike Mastery by 1% and All-Skill Mastery by 1% for 25 seconds, up to 20 stacks.
After releasing a Technique, if Kensei has sufficient Spiritual Pressure and is at the backline, he automatically releases Special Attacks until all his Spiritual Pressure is consumed.

rationale: Maxed core will give Kensei 320% Crit DMG. His B4 also provides him with an additional 50%. As with any characters, he also has a base of 50% Crit DMG. He does not need any Crit DMG substats.
